description: Our team brings together students from Computer Science, Information Technology, and Electrical Engineering, united by our passion for space, technology, and engineering. With diverse skills and perspectives, we are eager to explore new ideas, tackle challenging problems, and turn innovative concepts into practical solutions. We believe that collaboration, creativity, and curiosity are the keys to pushing boundaries and creating meaningful impact. We are excited to learn from one another, challenge the limits of what is possible, and build something extraordinary together.
